notes.title: N1L is Now Early Access!
notes.content: I was going to wait until the bugs were worked all the way out, but I need the Community to help find them and suggest ideas! So it has been a long time coming, but No1Lives! So, lets do this! The game is going live today! Hit me up with bugs! Let's rock this it!

notes.title: Dedicated Servers Added
notes.content: We've added the dedicated servers and added server search features to the game.
